name: Genoa Cristoforo Colombo Airport
before:
Liguria's airport, built on an artificial peninsula in the sea 7.4 km west of Genoa, which puts it in a small club alongside Nice, Venice, Gibraltar and Hong Kong. It serves the city and the Port of Genoa and draws from southern Piedmont as well.

It is not large. It handled 1,455,626 passengers in 2018, twenty first in Italy, and lost 14 routes in January 2022 when Volotea closed its base here after five years.

Ground transport takes a little explaining. The nearest station, Genova Sestri Ponente-Aeroporto, is linked to the terminal by an AMT bus called Airlink, and AMT also runs Volabus direct to Genoa's two main stations at Piazza Principe and Brignole. By road the A10 has its own Genova Aeroporto exit. Worth telling a client travelling in a group: for three or more people a fixed taxi fare can be agreed to the main stations.

The airport opened in 1962 and the current terminal dates from 1986. It is named after Christopher Columbus, who was born in the city.
after:
Genoa's airport, built on an artificial peninsula in the sea 7.4 km west of the city.

It is not large, but traffic grew fast in 2025: about 1.6 million passengers used it, up 18 per cent on 2024. Aeroitalia opened a base here in February 2026.

Ground transport takes a little explaining. The nearest station, Genova Sestri Ponente-Aeroporto, is linked to the terminal by an AMT bus called Airlink, and AMT also runs Volabus direct to Genoa's two main stations at Piazza Principe and Brignole. By road there is a dedicated Genova Aeroporto motorway exit.

The airport opened in 1962 and the terminal dates from 1986, extended by a new east wing in March 2025. It is named after Christopher Columbus.

claims.claim: traffic grew fast in 2025
claims.note: Replaces 'lost 14 routes in January 2022 when Volotea closed its base', which is now the wrong picture: 2025 was the airport's best year. The operator gives +18.1 per cent on 2024; Eurostat's 2024 and 2025 figures give the same. Pinned to 2025 because growth has since slowed: Assaeroporti's July 2026 table has Genoa up 3.1 per cent on July 2025.
